claim: Bounded single-corner (tt / 27 C / 1.80 V) measurement of the open-loop VCO's output duty and oscillation at the VCTRL values that reach the 2x-VCO rates 50, 100, 200 and 400 MHz (docs/phase-output-proposal.md section 10.3, issue #387). Duty D gives the derived CLK-CLK90 offset 180*D degrees from the closed form in sim/phase-quadrature-model/README.md; no divide-by-2 stage is simulated. Ratifies nothing; DR-010 stays Proposed.
spec_rows_note: Measured input to the DR-010 interface question only; no spec row is ratified.
methodology_note: One PVT point, one batched VCTRL grid (11 values, 0.3-1.0 V) in a single ngspice deck submitted with --executor batch; sub-0.8 V points lie below the lowest previously characterized VCTRL (sim/vco/records/20260904-163130-f3ae976.md) so non-oscillation there is data. tran_stop 800 ns / settle 400 ns so a 50 MHz (20 ns) period still yields several edges. Simulator options left at ngspice defaults, as in sim/vco.
analysis: transient per swept VCTRL value (`tran 50p 800n uic`, eleven values, one ngspice invocation at tt/27C/1.80V)
